verdict.rationale: The repo is effectively a single skill. Its install paths let you pull just that unit: a named plugin from the marketplace (logo-design@logo-design-skill), copying the one skill folder, or choosing a lite zip variant. These hint at granular installation, but there is no evidence of a multi-skill collection from which individual skills can be picked. Missing for 10: a documented collection of multiple skills, a per-skill selection mechanism within the bundle, and hands-on corroboration of selective install.
